_meta.ground_truth_rule: what the transcript text says; a block's person is the name the text binds to that block's speaker (self-naming, direct address by the next/previous speaker, or a called-on chain). Blocks with no naming evidence are gold 'unnamed' — no identity claim is possible from the text.

provenance_kinds.self-naming: the block's own turn contains an explicit self-naming cue
provenance_kinds.address-adjacent: an immediately adjacent turn addresses the block's speaker by name (greeting/thanks before, or reply after)
provenance_kinds.called-on: the host names the person and the block's turns answer that call
provenance_kinds.speech-continuity: the block continues a named speaker's speech mid-sentence or mid-argument across a label change
provenance_kinds.handover-next: a handover in an adjacent turn names the FOLLOWING speaker (never the speaking label)
